QuestInfo.name: The Village Hero
QuestInfo.0: Upon being released, Edward's first thought is not of escape. Instead, he wants to help the villagers who exiled him. By transforming and driving the Yetis off, the Snow Child has become the village hero. \r\nBut none of it would have been possible without your believing in him...
